name: RuVector
description: Stores and recalls persistent agent memory with local embeddings, vector search, and graph relationships, and serves it to coding agents over MCP.

skills.name: Remember and Recall
skills.description: Remembers decisions and facts, then recalls them by semantic similarity with npx ruvector hooks remember and recall.

skills.name: Vector Search
skills.description: Searches stored vectors by similarity with metadata filters from the Node.js, Python, or Rust APIs of the RuVector store.

skills.name: Graph Memory
skills.description: Stores nodes, edges, and hyperedges and queries relationships as Cypher paths through the ruvector-graph component.

skills.name: Serve Memory over MCP
skills.description: Serves project memory to MCP clients such as Claude Code, starting from a read-only tool profile until writes are allowed.

skills.name: Local Embeddings
skills.description: Embeds text locally with the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX model, so semantic memory works without a per-query API fee.
